title: Ridgeline Tool Rental: The ProBuild Rewards Discount Line
content:
The ProBuild Rewards rental discount on a Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement reaches the renter as a discount line on the agreement. The discount is posted once per agreement as one ProBuild discount line, and it never applies to damage protection, fees, deposits or lost equipment.

## Capability

`post_probuild_rental_discount_391bfaed` books a single ProBuild Rewards rental discount line, dated today, against the rental time of one Ridgeline Tool Rental agreement, and lowers the amount the renter owes on that agreement by exactly the amount posted. The renter sees the discount as its own line on the agreement and a lower balance. The tool records the amount it is given; it does not work the amount out.

## How it is invoked

This is an agent-side tool. The Customer Care agent unlocks `post_probuild_rental_discount_391bfaed` and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `rental_agreement_id` | The reference number of the rental agreement (one equipment item) the discount is posted on, as returned by the rental agreement lookup. | Id |
| `discount_amount` | The discount to post, in USD. | A positive number with 2 decimal places, no currency sign; the value is stored by standard rounding to 2 decimal places. |

## Return

On success the receipt returns:

- `status`: "posted" when the discount line was booked;
- `rental_charge_id`: the reference of the new discount line;
- `rental_agreement_id`: the agreement it was booked on;
- `amount`: the discount posted, USD with 2 decimal places;
- `balance_due`: the amount now owed on the agreement, USD with 2 decimal places, negative when the agreement is overpaid.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with `rental_agreement_id` set to an agreement's reference and `discount_amount` 214.50 on an agreement owing 1,180.00 returns `status` "posted", the new line's `rental_charge_id`, `amount` 214.50 and `balance_due` 965.50.
